citations.claim: Meta said further EU-required changes to its less-personalized ads offering could materially worsen user and advertiser experience and significantly hurt European revenue.

citations.claim: Meta projected full-year 2025 total expenses of $114 billion to $118 billion, up 20% to 24% year over year, narrowing its prior range of $113 billion to $118 billion.

Aside from infrastructure, we expect the second largest driver of growth to be employee compensation as we add technical talent in priority areas and recognize a full year of compensation expenses for employees hired throughout 2025. We expect these factors will result in a 2026 year over year expense growth rate that is above the 2025 expense growth rate.
